findings.title: Every request goes through one Product API

findings.title: Every request goes through one Product API
findings.message: It runs 1 replica, and every request from Shoppers goes through it: if it stops, Shoppers gets nothing.

findings.title: Failed messages to Shoppers are lost
findings.message: Shoppers fails some of what it's sent, and nothing delivers it again: there's no queue or topic in front of it to redeliver.

findings.title: Failed requests to Edge CDN are lost
findings.message: Edge CDN fails some of what it's sent, and nothing delivers it again: there's no queue or topic in front of it to redeliver.

output.simulations: Played 2 saved simulations (at most 60 s each).
